description.value: Omnitsky Kosher is one of Vancouver's only full-service kosher delicatessens, founded in Winnipeg in 1910 and operating in Vancouver since 1997. The deli handcrafts over 150 products — corned beef, pastrami, smoked meats, gluten-free hot dogs — using traditional recipes with no MSG or by-products. The 3435 Fraser Street location, opened May 2025, combines a retail deli store with a sit-down restaurant serving soups, deli sandwiches, burgers, and hot entrées.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address (3435 Fraser Street), phone (604-321-1818), and business identity. The about page confirms the Fraser Street location opened 2 May 2025, and all contact pages consistently list this address, though the homepage body text still says 'Come visit us on 5775 Oak Street,' suggesting a copy-paste lag from the prior Oak Street location. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or cycling infrastructure anywhere on the site; grocery and hot-food amenities are clearly confirmed from the restaurant menu and store descriptions.
concerns: Homepage body text still reads 'Come visit us on 5775 Oak Street!' — this appears to be stale copy from the prior location; the about page and all contact sections correctly list 3435 Fraser Street (opened 2 May 2025). Worth monitoring in case the website is not fully updated.
Copyright footer reads 2021, suggesting the website has not been fully refreshed since the location move.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible kosher deli and restaurant at the OSM address, with an active website and confirmed contact details. Useful to touring cyclists for food resupply and hot meals.

Hot food.detail: On-site kosher deli restaurant serves soups from scratch, deli sandwiches (5 oz and 8 oz), hot dogs, burgers, chicken wings, open-face roast beef with gravy and fries, and breakfast items
